source: https://roco.world（属性免疫说明 + 技能描述）

marks.name: Burn

params.note: 每回合末造成最大生命 2% 伤害并层数减半；层数减半逻辑【待校准】，尚未实现。

marks.rawText: At the end of the turn, deals Fire-type damage equal to 2% of Health and halves the stack count. (Fire-type Jinies are immune to this effect.)

marks.name: Poison

params.note: 每回合末造成最大生命 3% 伤害。层数是否影响伤害【待校准】。

marks.rawText: At the end of each turn, deals Poison-type damage equal to 3% of Health. (Poison-type Jinies are immune to this effect.)

marks.name: Freeze

params.note: 冻结最大生命 5%；当前生命低于该比例则阵亡。斩殺阈值判定【待校准】。

marks.rawText: Freezes 5% of Health. If current Health is below the frozen percentage, the Jini faints. (Ice-type Jinies are immune to this effect.)

marks.name: Starfall Mark

params.note: 非幻象系技能攻击携带者时触发，消耗全部星陨层数并造成额外幻象系伤害。伤害公式【待校准】，暂未实现。

marks.rawText: When a non-Illusion-type skill attacks a Jini with this mark, Starfall Mark triggers, consumes all Starfall stacks, and deals extra Illusion-type damage to that Jini.

marks.name: Parasitism

params.note: 每回合末吸取携带者最大生命 2% 回复来源；来源方记录【待校准】。

marks.rawText: At the end of each turn, this effect absorbs 2% Health from the source of the parasitism. (Grass-type Jinies are immune to this effect.)

marks.name: Conductive Charge

params.note: 叠到 2 层立即受雷系 25% 伤害并清 2 层。

marks.rawText: When a Jini gains 2 stacks of Conductive Charge, it immediately takes Electric-type damage equal to 25% of its Health and loses 2 stacks of Conductive Charge. (Electric-type Jinies are immune to this effect.)
